name: Easy chicken gyoza with lace crust — optimized (גיוזה Easy Mode, גרסה ממוטבת)

source.author: Optimized version of chicken_gyoza_easy_lace
source.notes: Optimized version of chicken_gyoza_easy_lace, adopted per user request. Changes: chili crunch removed from the filling (optional dab in the dip only), lace oil halved to ½ tbsp, low-sodium soy in both filling and dip. Chicken BREAST mince, Shimrit ready-rolled chilled wrappers, same fold/lace method. ~20 gyoza = 4 servings; dip counted at ~50% consumed. Estimate.

ingredients.note: halved — a nonstick pan still gives a crisp skirt
kept out of the filling; just a dab in the dip if you want heat

steps: Wet the wrapper edges, add ~1 tbsp filling and pinch closed across the top, leaving the sides open.
Whisk the lace mixture (water, flour, oil).
Fry the gyoza in a lightly oiled nonstick pan over medium until the bottoms are golden; stir the lace mix and pour in just enough to cover the pan base.
Cover ~1 min to steam, then uncover and let the water evaporate until the lace dries and crisps. Lower the heat if the bottoms brown too fast.

batch_totals.note: ~20 gyoza + ~half the dip, optimized. Vs the original: ~57 kcal and ~6 g fat less per 5 gyoza, sodium down ~38% (~583 vs ~934 mg), same protein.

him.verdict: Same lean chicken-breast protein (~22.5 g per 5 gyoza) for ~284 kcal (~7.9 g protein per 100 kcal), with fat cut to ~8.7 g and sodium down ~38% by dropping the chili crunch from the filling, halving the lace oil and using low-sodium soy. Still refined wrappers with little fibre — serve with greens or edamame.
flags: fat ~14.7 g/serving — sesame oil + lace oil + chili crunch
sodium ~934 mg/serving — soy in filling + dip, plus miso
suggested_mods: Serve with steamed greens / edamame for fibre
Dip lightly — the dip is the remaining sodium lever

her_preconception.verdict: Lean, fully cooked chicken protein with much lower sodium than the original. Not a folate/iron source on its own — pair with a vegetable side. Make sure the filling is cooked through after steaming.

safety_advisories.note: Minced chicken must be cooked through — check a gyoza is firm/opaque inside after steaming.
safety_advisories.swap: steam a little longer if unsure

suggested_mods: Low-sodium soy; serve with greens or edamame for folate

cooking_guide: Keep the filling cold and mix it well — it binds better and is easier to spoon.
Only ~1 tbsp filling per wrapper; overfilling stops the top seal from holding.
Wet just the edges, not the whole wrapper, so it seals without going gummy.
Brown the bottoms first on medium, then add the lace — the order is what gives a crisp base plus a steamed top.
Re-stir the lace mix right before pouring (the flour sinks), and pour only a thin layer across the pan base.
After ~1 min covered, uncover and let it fry until the skirt is dry, golden and releases easily — flip onto a plate in one piece.
adopted_note: Adopted 2026-11-07 (optimized). Per ~5 gyoza (of ~20): ~284 kcal, 22.5 g protein, 8.7 g fat, ~583 mg sodium. him 8 / her 7. Standing spec: no chili crunch in the filling, ½ tbsp lace oil, low-sodium soy in filling + dip, chicken breast mince, Shimrit chilled wrappers. Serve with greens/edamame.
